prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `crt(residues, moduli)` in src/lib.rs, the Chinese remainder theorem. The slices must have equal length, every modulus must be positive, and the moduli must be pairwise coprime. Return the unique solution in `[0, lcm)` as `Some(i64)`, or `None` when the input is inconsistent or the result cannot be represented in `i64`. Two empty slices return `Some(0)`. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
